notes.title: Wishlist Milestone & Prize Pool Update
notes.notes:
Kinky Cats has been added to the Steam wishlist by 10,000 people! Thank you for your incredible support!



Next milestone is 15,000 and we're ready to pump up the rewards!



We will distribute all prizes among players who log into Kinky Cats during the first few days of release. Add Kinky Cats to your wishlist on Steam and unlock even more rewards in the early days of launch!
